sentences.text: Hoy Pedro va a la ciudad.
sentences.english: Today Pedro goes to the city.

sentences.text: En la ciudad hay muchas casas y muchas tiendas.
sentences.english: In the city there are many houses and many shops.

sentences.text: En la tienda hay pan, agua y café.
sentences.english: In the shop there is bread, water and coffee.

sentences.text: Pedro quiere pan y café para su familia.
sentences.english: Pedro wants bread and coffee for his family.

sentences.text: Pedro compra el pan y el café.
sentences.english: Pedro buys the bread and the coffee.

sentences.text: Pedro va a la casa en el carro.
sentences.english: Pedro goes home in the car.
